tagline: Nairobi's one-stop shop for car accessories, body parts and lighting
description: Customcarz Auto Care has served car owners, mechanics, garages and dealers from Nairobi CBD since 2020, stocking new imports from China and genuine ex-Japan spare parts, with installation services in tinting, wraps, lighting and vehicle electronics.
vision: To be one of Kenya’s most trusted destinations for car accessories, spare parts, styling, lighting and vehicle technology.
